vote.question: [US-ME - U.S. Senate]: Susan M. Collins (R) has received $56,008,902 in career campaign contributions (with $22,465,218 this cycle, alongside $81,452,027 in outside Super PAC support led by Senate Leadership Fund (SLF PAC))—linked to "Private Equity, Speculative Finance & Real Estate Syndicate". Do you vote to formally rebuke Susan M. Collins for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Susan M. Collins has amassed $56,008,902 in career contributions (with $22,465,218 this cycle, alongside $81,452,027 in outside Super PAC support led by Senate Leadership Fund (SLF PAC))—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Susan M. Collins on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).

bounty_if_no_wins.description: Community Commons for US-ME: If residents decide against the restitution fund, 100% of the funds go directly to essential local community services in US-ME (Volunteer Fire/EMS, Veterans' Care, Food Banks, and Disaster Relief).
